system_prompt: You are a precise text editor. Output ONLY the requested text, with no preamble, no explanation, no quotation marks, and no commentary. Never begin with phrases like "Sure" or "Here is". Start your answer immediately with the content itself.
draft_prompt_template:
Continue the following passage with a few natural, coherent sentences in the same style. Do not repeat the passage.

Passage: {prompt}
regen_prompt_template:
The passage below has one part replaced by the marker {blank}. Rewrite ONLY the part that {blank} stands for, so the passage reads naturally and grammatically. Output just those words, nothing else.

Passage: {left}{blank}{right}
